title.en: Housing and Development (Precincts for Lift Upgrading Works) (No. 2) Order 2023

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Housing and Development (Precincts for Lift Upgrading Works) (No. 2) Order 2023 and comes into operation on 12 May 2023.

heading.en: Declaration of precincts for lift upgrading works

text.en: 2. The parts of the housing estates of the Board described in the Schedule are declared to be precincts for the purpose of carrying out lift upgrading works.

THE SCHEDULE
1. All that part of the housing estate of the Board:
(a)bounded by Cashew Road and Petir Road, comprised in Lot number 00526M in Mukim 14 and on which Apartment Block 130 is erected, and which is more particularly delineated in Plan 1A;
Plan 1A
Cashew ROAD/Gangsa ROAD/petir road
(b)bounded by Gangsa Road and Petir Road, comprised in Lot number 00394L in Mukim 14 and on which Apartment Blocks 147 and 151 are erected, and which is more particularly delineated in Plan 1B.
Plan 1B
cashew ROAD/gangsa ROAD/petir road

(a)bounded by Gangsa Road, Petir Road and Bukit Panjang Road, comprised in Lot number 01060V in Mukim 14 and on which Apartment Blocks 101 and 107 are erected, and which is more particularly delineated in Plan 2A;
